appearance.identity: Warm stone palace with low wings, two courtyards, stepped clock tower, ornamental crowns and green spire.
appearance.exclusions: Interiors, underground works and neighboring city blocks.

brief: Budgeted Palace of Culture complex preserves both courtyard openings, ceremonial eastern portico, low wings, central terrace/clock shaft and rounded Congress Hall. Far tiers merge windows, crenellations and unseen bottoms; original detailed source remains reproducible.

sourceFacts.reviewScope: Original183246-triangle18016896-byte source reproduced exactly; detailed original recipe preserved. Independent browser derivatives retain the distinguishing exterior with tiered detail.
sourceFacts.currentRoundCorrection: Inset masonry necks join the149/151.4m and173/175.4m stages; original detailed master remains independent.

geographic.notes: One inspected operator exterior detail photograph establishes the warm stone upper shaft, pale clock faces and ornamental terrace/crowns. The original237m height,114m terrace, stepped tower, low complex wings, eastern portico, two courtyard holes and rounded Congress Hall remain authored/mapped controls. Retain the exact-QID concave relation and signed frame; native-Z points toward the eastern entrance and Congress Hall remains at native+Z. Standard viewer PMTiles confirms the complex and road context. Off-footprint PMTiles[-150,0]115.0133m sets approximate terrain contact; center124.8438m contains coarse urban imprint. Rectangular preview correction covers the full complex with raw heights kept separately. Exact sculpture, ceramic ornament, mermaid emblems, window schedule, interior halls and threshold elevations remain approximations or excluded. The cropped picture does not certify the whole low-wing layout; existing mapped controls are retained.
